Project.NAME: aura_coffee
Project.keywords: coffee-shop, ordering, payment, delivery, fastapi, react, monolith
Project.annotation: Production web platform for a single-location coffee shop — online ordering with pickup and own-courier delivery.

M-CORE-API.NAME: core-api
M-CORE-API.purpose: FastAPI HTTP server — business logic, CRUD, auth, all state mutations

export-routers.PURPOSE: HTTP route handlers (auth, menu, orders, payment, delivery, addresses, admin/*)

export-services.PURPOSE: Business logic services (order, payment, delivery, notification, admin_users)

export-models.PURPOSE: SQLAlchemy ORM models (User, Order, OrderItem, Payment, Delivery, MenuItem, Promocode, ShopSettings)

export-schemas.PURPOSE: Pydantic request/response schemas per router, including public menu media fields

M-PAYMENT-WORKER.NAME: payment-worker
M-PAYMENT-WORKER.purpose: Celery worker — YuKassa payments, webhooks, refunds

export-tasks.PURPOSE: Celery tasks for payment intent creation, webhook processing, refunds

M-SMS-WORKER.NAME: sms-worker
M-SMS-WORKER.purpose: Celery worker — SMS.ru OTP codes and order notifications

export-tasks.PURPOSE: Celery tasks for OTP send and order status SMS

export-pages.PURPOSE: Top-level routed pages (menu, cart, checkout, profile, orders)

export-features.PURPOSE: Feature-scoped components, hooks, stores, and menu media presentation

M-WEB-ADMIN.NAME: web-admin
M-WEB-ADMIN.purpose: React SPA — staff panel: admin, barista, courier views, menu media path editing

export-pages.PURPOSE: Top-level routed pages (orders feed, kitchen, delivery, users, settings)

export-features.PURPOSE: Role-scoped components and hooks (admin, barista, courier), including admin menu media fields

M-SHARED.NAME: shared
M-SHARED.purpose: Shared Python package — domain enums, constants, validation, GRACE LDD logger

export-enums.PURPOSE: Domain enums (OrderStatus, PaymentStatus, DeliveryStatus, OtpStatus, UserStatus, PromoStatus) per PDD §6

export-seeds.PURPOSE: Seed data scripts for menu, roles, default shop settings

CrossLink.relation: imports domain enums and pydantic helpers
depends on schema and migrations applied at runtime
reads and writes order and payment tables
receives webhook events forwarded by core-api
receives task dispatches via Celery from core-api
seed scripts use shared enums for valid initial values
